entries.idea: The shipped bars (D51 line bar, D64 prop bar, D58 reasons) re-read with their error bars clustered by game (same-game bets move together)
entries.bar: A segment or reason on at full stakes under the plain error that is off under the clustered one is flagged; a rule is reverted only where the clustered replay's record (the bar's own place, replay-record.mjs barPlace) shows the rule losing units against no rule, else flagged in DECISIONS

entries.idea: Live routine props bet only in a late window before the start (D61's curve: value rises toward the start); confirmed by a research replay of the props placed at the intraday snapshot hours
entries.bar: Per sport, on the same prop keys: a placement hour H is no better than the close-only replay unless its flat ROI leads by 1.645 game-clustered SEs; the late window stands if no earlier hour leads the close beyond that, and is reported reversed if an earlier hour does

results.text: Research replay (optimistic: close-time facts): no hour beats close-only on the same keys in any sport; NBA early -20 to -38u, NFL noise (3h +2.2u vs -0.5u, SE 2.4pts), NHL close +38u vs +11-13u, MLB tie. The late window stands (bet as near the close as the runs reach).

REGISTERED AFTER ONE MEASUREMENT (the one variant below, run once before this entry; nothing else tried)
entries.bar: Ships if the replay's units on the same bets rise and the gate finds no layer worse; reported as inside the noise where the units' gain is under 1.645 SEs

results.text: NHL replay -17.29u -> -11.11u on the same 3803 bets (LIKE -43.07u -> -36.89u, LOVE unchanged +25.78u); gate TIES, SHIP; the gain inside the noise (about 0.2 SEs on the stepped bets)

entries.idea: Polymarket's top sports wallets (today's sports leaderboard via the free public data API: all-time top 300 and month top 100; Gamma events and CLOB prices, no key, no spend) as a signal for the game lines. A wallet is scored walk-forward at a moment from its trades resolved before it alone: 500+ settled sports trades and a positive profit at price on 20+ matched trades (polymarket-sharps.mjs walletScorer). The scored wallets' net USDC flow on a matched market's home/over side before the Bot's bet moment (the archive's open snapshot; trades timestamped before it only) shifts the priced chance toward their side: KAPPA points at a net of 10,000 USDC or more, in proportion under it, nothing under 1,000 (polymarket.mjs polySignal, POLY_SIGNAL=<variant>). The universe (today's leaderboard) is chosen with hindsight; the write-up says so. Props out of scope.
entries.bar: Ships only if the champion/challenger gate (gate.mjs --candidate env:POLY_SIGNAL=<variant> --champion origin/master nba nhl mlb nfl) says SHIP in every sport with the recency veto passed; a beat-the-fair-close share or flat-ROI gain inside 1.645 game-clustered standard errors is inside the noise and is reported so, never a reason to ship. Step 2 (the sharps' own positions against the fair close, by sport and market, game-clustered SE against one half) and step 4 (Polymarket's close price as a second no-vig reference) are measurements only and ship nothing.
